summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 53 on Artificial Intelligence and 22 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Fitbit’s AI health coach will soon be able to read your medical records
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Security Firm Aura Discloses Data Breach Impacting 900,000 Records
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
